title: What Is Starshield, SpaceX’s Military-Grade Satellite Internet Service Ukraine Relies On?
summary: For years, Ukraine’s armed forces have relied on satellite communication services developed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. Recent restrictions have hampered its war effort.
